Your learning playground.

Pick a quest, read the pattern guide, and play its animation. Write a real Java solution, then Run the sample cases or Submit quest against every built-in case.

Earn 100 XP for your first accepted solution. Review it after 2, 7 and 21 days. Challenge mode adds an optional timer when you feel ready.

The first Java run downloads a browser JDK from CheerpJ. It needs internet and may take a minute. Your code executes on this device. Test cases are public practice checks, and execution times are local measurements.

Drafts, notes and progress stay in this browser. Use Save progress for a backup. This is a personal learning app; it has no accounts or shared leaderboard.
